findings.description: Missing external calendar ID leaves updates without a destination — Without a selected calendar, updates may target an undefined or unintended calendar ID. Fall back to the destination calendar’s external ID when `externalCalendarId` is absent.

Missing destination calendar crashes Google Meet fallback — A Meet booking without a destination calendar crashes during event creation. Optional-chain `mainHostDestinationCalendar` so a missing destination follows the non-Google fallback.

Sync endpoint returns a Fetch Response instead of token data — Provider callers expect token data, so returning a Fetch `Response` leaves `token.access_token` undefined and breaks refresh. Parse the response and return the provider-shaped result, or update callers to consume a common parsed result.
Retry cleanup deletes reminders for non-SMS methods — Email and other non-SMS reminders can be deleted when their `retryCount` exceeds 1. Restrict this branch to `WorkflowMethods.SMS` as well.

Substring origin check accepts forged resize messages — An unrelated origin embedded in `discourseUrl` can send forged `discourse-resize` messages and change the frame height. Compare `e.origin` with the exact parsed origin of `discourseUrl`.

downsize's geometry overload breaks width/height callers — `ResizeEmoji` still passes width, height, and options, which raises an argument-count error because Ruby replaces the earlier `downsize` definition. Keep one `downsize` method that accepts both call forms, or update all callers to use a geometry string.

Image downsize geometry does not constrain both dimensions — The generated `80%>` geometry does not bound both dimensions, so images may remain above the upload-size limit. Pass explicit dimensions or use a supported percentage geometry that constrains both axes.

Oversized images trigger repeated identical conversions — Repeated synchronous ImageMagick conversions consume CPU and delay uploads, even when each conversion leaves the target unchanged. Derive a target that converges in one bounded conversion, or avoid retrying with the same target.
Exact page counts report an extra page — Exact multiples show an empty extra page. Update `totalPages` to use the ceiling of `user_count / limit`.
Concurrent registrations can exceed the device limit — Make `CountDevices` and the insert atomic, using a transaction with appropriate serialization.

Legacy create is canceled when the request context ends — A client disconnect or completed request can cancel the legacy write, dropping the safety copy for a successful unified write. Derive the bounded context from `context.WithoutCancel(ctx)`.

Access-token matcher rejects the expected grant shortcut — Correctly generated token IDs are rejected, while IDs with the wrong grant can pass. Reverse the conditional so only a matching `expectedGrantShortcut` is accepted.

Opted-in table widgets receive empty visualization data — Opted-in dashboard table widgets render blank because `TableWidgetVisualization` receives empty data and metadata. Pass `result.data` and `result.meta`, and derive `columns` from the widget query.
